$description: Design-policy binding (R15). Category chosen from evidence; the binding and the local extension are DEFINED, pending the owner's architecture review. An agent never ratifies its own classification.

evidence: A single person's work index: home = intro, selected-work grid of 10 projects, statement sequence, contact (src/App.jsx HomePage).
Six project write-up articles + not-found; no pricing, plans, sign-up, log-in, account or dashboard routes (templates/routes.json; ia.json).
Conversion is limited to an email link, social links and one font download (contact.footer-cta, article.download-cta).
Audience is visitors/employers of an individual designer, not buyers of a product.

rules: Generated pages must not identify or reproduce the source owner, projects, copy, URLs or media (GENERATED_MODE_* rules; policy/source-identity.json).
No depiction of real people: portraits are fictional-portrait or user-supplied-portrait only.
No live third-party embeds or downloads in generated pages (placeholder-embed / placeholder-download on reserved .example hosts).
Statement stages stay one contiguous 4-stage sticky sequence; motion always carries its reducedMotionFallback.
Style values only from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json under tokens/llm/token-policy.json.
